text.offer: Tendrath says, "Below Brax, past the graveyard and the decaying city, there is a maze. Something lives in it that wears the shape of whatever you expect to see. In the heart of that maze is a node of mana. I never reached it. Perhaps you will."
text.progress: From the Cragged Mountains: the Winding Caverns, the Ancient Graveyard of Brax, the Decaying City of Brax, and into the Maze of the Mimic.
text.complete: You found it. Then my searching was not for nothing.

steps.objective: Bond with the node in the Maze of the Mimic
